selected_primary_idea.title: MARS-CELL: a resource-to-release manufacturing-cell audit for Mars
selected_primary_idea.summary: A bounded product-family protocol that couples feedstock lots, process routes, environment/energy profiles, inspection contracts, and recovery decisions before any locally made item is considered for use.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: First-generation manufacturing cells for non-critical Mars construction and repair products
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Coupled release dossiers give more reproducible and operationally meaningful manufacturing-readiness evidence than coupon-only, printability-only, or local-content-only claims.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Predeclare a bounded product family and audit every candidate with feedstock, process, environment-energy, inspection-release, and recovery cards.

competitive_ideas.title: Route-only regolith additive manufacturing
competitive_ideas.reason: Does not close quality, energy, and recovery interfaces.

competitive_ideas.title: Maximum local-content optimizer
competitive_ideas.reason: Can reward unsafe substitution rather than releaseable products.

high_risk_ideas.reason: Evidence, safety, and mission scope exceed a bounded early-manufacturing-cell proposal.
